# MoveLite third-party notices

MoveLite redistributes the following original model and runtime files without
modification. Its own integration code changes loading paths and UI messages.

- Transformers.js 3.8.1: Hugging Face and contributors, Apache-2.0.
- ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4: Microsoft and contributors,
  MIT and the upstream full ThirdPartyNotices.txt.
- BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5, Xenova ONNX revision
  75c43b069aac4d136ba6bc1122f995fedcfd2781: model cards and FlagEmbedding MIT
  license retained alongside tokenizer/configuration files.

[Full license and source inventory](licenses/model-runtime/README.md) includes
copyright notices, upstream license texts, dependency metadata, fixed-version
model cards and download verification records. These third-party licenses are
separate from the application's own source code.

[model-assets.json](model-assets.json) records the exact resource paths, byte
lengths, SHA-256 values and pinned upstream source URLs.
